what: Horizontal banner slider — the panel slides one slot over 1s easeOutQuad, rests 5s, then moves on. In the dot row below, the current dot turns green, and a 4px bar from that dot toward the next one fills linearly (no curve) up to 36px over 6s (rest + slide). After the switch, the old bar shrinks toward the right dot after .1s over .3s and disappears (toward the left when going back). Arrows, dots and a horizontal drag (50px) switch manually, and the whole panel is cloned front and back to loop endlessly

options.hold: Hold length (seconds), default 5 — the bar fills during hold + dur
options.gap: Gap between dots (px), default 30 — css gets it too via --fx-gap
options.ease: Push curve, default power1.out (jQuery easing easeOutQuad)
options.swipe: Horizontal distance (px) you must drag to flip, default 50 — Brand card photo 40
options.--fx-dot·--fx-dot-on: Dot color and current-dot color (via style), default --kf-line and --kf-accent. For Brand the current dot is ink (--kf-ink)
options.--fx-dot-size: Dot diameter (via style), default 8px — Brand’s original uses design unit .7 (about 7px at 1440)

note: The panel frame (mask) height, corners and border are supplied by the consumer (original is a 1050×320 ratio, 12px corners, 2px inner line). The dots and bars are created by this part inside dots.
